scripts.build: pnpm build:core && pnpm build:node-core && pnpm build:ui-core && pnpm build:ui-sci-blocks && pnpm build:ui-texteditor && pnpm build:viewers && pnpm build:ui-ai && pnpm build:ui-scene3d && pnpm build:ui-devtools && pnpm build:ui-markdown-editor && pnpm build:web-finances && pnpm build:finances && pnpm build:web-iot && pnpm build:iot && pnpm build:cad && pnpm build:drive && pnpm build:platform
scripts.build:viewers: pnpm build:ui-core && pnpm build:ui-sci-blocks && pnpm build:ui-texteditor && pnpm --filter @hestia/viewers run build
scripts.build:ui-ai: pnpm build:ui-core && pnpm build:ui-sci-blocks && pnpm build:ui-texteditor && pnpm --filter @hestia/ui-ai run build
scripts.build:ui-scene3d: pnpm --filter @hestia/ui-cad run build && pnpm --filter @hestia/ui-scene3d run build
scripts.dev: concurrently -n platforma,iot,web -c blue,cyan,green --kill-others "pnpm dev:platform" "pnpm dev:iot" "pnpm dev:web-iot"
scripts.dev:finances: concurrently -n backend,web -c blue,green --kill-others "pnpm --filter finances-backend run dev" "pnpm --filter finances-web run dev"
scripts.dev:cad: concurrently -n platform,cad,web -c blue,cyan,green --kill-others "pnpm dev:platform" "pnpm --filter cad-backend run dev" "pnpm --filter cad-web run dev"
scripts.dev:drive: concurrently -n platform,drive,web -c blue,cyan,green --kill-others "pnpm dev:platform" "pnpm --filter drive-backend run dev" "pnpm --filter drive-web run dev"
scripts.clean: pnpm -r exec rm -rf dist && rm -rf app/cad/public app/drive/public app/finances/public app/iot/public
scripts.clean:deps: find . -name node_modules -type d -prune -exec rm -rf {} + && echo 'run: pnpm install'
